title: Mac上的ChatGPT客户端，他做到了月入21万
title_en: ChatGPT Client for Mac, He Hit $210K/Month
title_jp: Mac用ChatGPTクライアントで月収21万ドル達成
title_ar: عميل ChatGPT لنظام Mac، حقق 210 ألف دولار شهريا
carouselChartTitle: Mac上的ChatGPT客户端，他做到了月入21万
author: 阿星

{"ops": [{"insert": "Mac上的ChatGPT客户端，他做到了月入21万"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一次性买断，不靠订阅，利润率高达90%", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分人做AI工具，都在卷API、卷功能、卷价格。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel Nguyen走了一条不一样的路。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做了个Mac上的ChatGPT客户端，叫BoltAI。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一次性买断，不强制订阅。现在月入1.5-3万美元，利润率接近90%。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel不是新手。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "15年前，他在网上卖开源论坛插件，赚到了第一桶金。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来辍学创业，做WordPress咨询服务，年入10万美元。但关停了，去大公司当产品工程师。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年，他在Twitter发现了独立开发者社区。从此一发不可收拾。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他是solo founder，在越南胡志明市，同时运营三个产品："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "BoltAI（AI客户端）——月入1.5-3万", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PDF Pals（PDF聊天）——月入1-2千", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "KTool（文章推送到Kindle）——月入1.5千", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个真正成功的产品是KTool。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel半失明，想尽量把阅读迁移到Kindle上。所以做了这个工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他在Hacker News发布，上了首页，排名第二，挂了快两天。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但做了一年后，他发现自己不擅长营销，而且这个市场在萎缩。技术上也很挑战，要为每个网站做定制解析器。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他决定转向AI，学OpenAI API，找相关的自由职业项目。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "项目没找到，但找到了新点子——BoltAI。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel完全不懂Swift开发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他用ChatGPT学。概念验证（PoC）的代码，一半是用GPT-4生成的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几天就做完了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个版本很简陋。没有自动更新，他手动发zip文件给早期用户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "功能也简单：在任何文本框输入，按快捷键，AI把结果填回去。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "解决什么问题？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不用在Mac应用和ChatGPT网页间来回切换了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当时还没有ChatGPT桌面应用。很多人有同样的痛点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "上线当天就卖出去了几份。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式上，Daniel吃过亏。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "KTool是订阅制，他发现消费者讨厌订阅。所以BoltAI改走永久授权，送1年更新。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是桌面软件的传统模式。但纯永久授权对独立开发者不友好，不持续。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是他改成"1年更新"模式，类似JetBrains的做法。他觉得这样公平，用户有控制权。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从第一天就收费，没有免费增值。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个版本卖9美元。然后逐步涨价到19、29......现在高级版100美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有趣的是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从9美元涨到79美元，没有反弹，销量反而涨了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但从79涨到110，总收入没变，销量下降了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最后定在100美元，甜点价格。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "怎么推广的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel说自己是幸运的。在AI热潮中，Twitter上发布MVP就病毒式传播了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他也做了很多事："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI目录站", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " —— 当时AI产品不多，新发布能获得很多关注"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PPC广告", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " —— 在目录站买广告，早期挺有效，但后来发现只 targeting AI爱好者不够"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "社区", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " —— 跟最活跃的客户聊，为他们定制功能。然后把进展分享到独立开发者和Mac应用社区"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还推荐了三个免费推广渠道："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "MacApps subreddit —— Reddit用户爱折扣，可以每次发帖给个小优惠码", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Indie Apps Sales —— 被MacStories、9to5Mac等报道的机会", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "黑五优惠目录 —— 找deal的人不全是目标客户，但有一部分是", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最成功的实验是"}, {"insert": "免费工具", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——工程即营销。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他把BoltAI的一些功能，或者一些小点子，打包成独立的小工具，免费发布。这些工具持续带来高质量的潜在客户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他还在做SEO，跟SEO agency合作，从帮助文档和免费工具获得流量。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有一个里程碑——BoltAI加入了Setapp，开辟了新的收入来源，还带来了大量曝光。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniel的经历说明——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有时候，简单的想法反而更有效。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "BoltAI不是什么复杂的技术创新。就是让用户少点几下鼠标，少切几次窗口。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这个痛点足够真实，足够普遍。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "再加上选对时机（AI热潮）、选对模式（一次性买断赢了一波好感）、持续迭代，就做起来了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他最后推荐了一堆资源："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Jason Cohen的博客", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Startups for the Rest of Us播客", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Rob Walling的SaaS Playbook", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Traction", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The 1-page Marketing Plan", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Obviously Awesome", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些都是经典。感兴趣的朋友可以去看看。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: ChatGPT client on Mac he achieved two hundred ten thousand monthly income. One time purchase not subscription profit margin up to ninety percent. Most people making AI tools are competing on API features price. Daniel Nguyen took different path. He made ChatGPT client on Mac called BoltAI. One time purchase not forced subscription. Now monthly income fifteen to thirty thousand dollars profit margin close to ninety percent. One. Daniel is not newcomer. Fifteen years ago he sold open source forum plugin earned first bucket of money. Later dropped out started WordPress consulting business annual income one hundred thousand dollars. But shut it down went to big company as product engineer. Twenty twenty two he discovered independent developer community on Twitter. From then unstoppable. Now he is solo founder in Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam operating three products simultaneously. BoltAI AI client monthly income fifteen to thirty thousand. PDF Pals PDF chat monthly income one to two thousand. KTool article push to Kindle monthly income one point five thousand. Two. First truly successful product was KTool. Daniel was half blind wanted to migrate reading to Kindle as much as possible so made this tool. He posted on Hacker News reached front page ranked second stayed for almost two days.
